note: Smart agricultural switch: 4 layers, 218 footprints, mixed mains-side power switching + MCU/radio control, dense discrete count

User-submitted via issue #614 (author could not route it). 8-layer 70x45mm mezzanine RX card: Microchip IGLOO2 VF400 400-ball 0.8mm-pitch FPGA, KSZ VQFN64 Ethernet switch carrying 8 MDI diff pairs, Alliance FBGA54 SDRAM, 2x 122-pad TE mezzanine connectors. Ships a real .kicad_dru DFM ruleset (0.127mm general clearance, 0.6mm high-speed isolation, 135deg track-angle) and a 0.09mm netclass floor. NEVER human-routed: the reference in boards_set28/ has 0 segments/0 vias, so compare_to_original is meaningless. Hardest board in the corpus: 91.1% vs a 100% median.
2 GHz active oscilloscope probe: 4 layers, JFET/opamp RF front end, SMA/coax input, few nets but tight analog geometry

Storm Tracker: 4-layer 36.5x69mm ESP32-C6-MINI-1U lightning detector (AS3935 antenna front end, 1.54in e-paper on a 24-pin 0.5mm FFC, USB-C + battery charger, buzzer, buttons). Small but DENSE: 342 vias and 549 segments in ~2500mm2, 0.13mm min track/clearance fab floor, 0.5mm-pitch FFC and a 61-pad module. One of only two corpus boards with a real .kicad_dru -- and unlike mez_rx's DFM ruleset its single rule is CONDITIONED on a netclass (A.NetClass == '90R_DP' && B.NetName == 'GND', F.Cu, 0.15mm), with the USB pair assigned to that class by PATTERN (*USB_D* -> 90R_DP) rather than by an explicit net list. Fully human-routed, so compare_to_original is meaningful.
